finding.claim: Embed code fetched from remote providers is emitted raw, bypassing html_input; with default empty embed.allowed_domains, any https URL is fetched and its HTML inserted (plausible stored XSS / SSRF, not verified against embed/embed library).
finding.source: Markdown bare https:// line (src/Extension/Embed/EmbedStartParser.php:34) and remote oEmbed/embed response
finding.sink: src/Extension/Embed/EmbedRenderer.php:33 returns getEmbedCode() unescaped; set at src/Extension/Embed/Bridge/OscaroteroEmbedAdapter.php:46
finding.guards_checked: html_input is not applied to embed output; EmbedExtension.php:38-41 applies DomainFilteringAdapter only when allowed_domains is non-empty (default []). No vendor source available to confirm embed/embed oEmbed behavior.

finding.claim: Embed domain allowlist is checked only on the original URL; redirects from an allowed host are not re-validated, enabling SSRF to non-allowlisted/internal hosts if the embed library follows redirects (plausible, unverified).
finding.source: Markdown https:// embed URL on an allowlisted domain that redirects to another host

trace.note: updateEmbeds filters with isAllowed before delegating
isAllowed parses only the original URL scheme and host
getMulti fetches; redirect following not checked against allowlist

finding.guards_checked: Scheme must be http/https (DomainFilteringAdapter.php:47); host must equal or be a subdomain of an allowed domain (lines 51-58). No post-redirect host check. Redirect behaviour of embed/embed not verified (no vendor source).

finding.claim: Static lastCursor/lastCursorLacksClosingBrace cache is keyed only on cursor identity, not byte position, so a failed <dest> attempt suppresses a later valid <dest> link on the same paragraph (confirmed logic bug, fails closed, low severity).
finding.source: Markdown paragraph such as [a](<b) [c](<d>) with a failed angle-bracket destination followed by a valid one
finding.sink: Protected operation: link destination parse returns null for valid <...> destination (LinkParserHelper.php:151-154)

trace.note: one Cursor created per block, shared by all inline parsers
tryParseInlineLinkAndTitle calls parseLinkDestination on the shared cursor
cursor at '<' routes only to parseDestinationBraces, no raw fallback
same cursor object and lacksClosingBrace flag returns null without checking position

finding.guards_checked: WeakReference identity check (line 151) guards object lifetime only; no position check. Regex skip is an optimisation, and failure at an earlier position does not imply failure at a later one. Impact is missing link rendering, not an output bypass.
